config:
[server]
auth_mode = "none"
allow_dynamic_routes = false

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.chatup]
dialect = "openai-chat"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}"
api_key = "upstream-secret"

[[models]]
name = "bridge-chat"
provider = "chatup"
model = "gpt-4o-mini"

[capabilities.overrides."bridge-chat".reasoning.toggle]
supported = false
name: anthropic_to_chat_thinking_strict
_comment: Disabled thinking now reaches the shared planner. An explicit unsupported toggle retains strict translation-loss refusal before any upstream I/O.
